newsitems.title: 60,000 wishlists. Out on November 24!
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! Shred a Billion just passed 60,000 wishlists. Nine days ago it was 30,000, so the number doubled in just over a week. Thank you so much! ❤️ Every wishlist really matters for a small game like mine. It tells Steam to show the game to more people, and it means you get a notification the moment the game is out. Out on November 24 The full game comes out in 2 days, on November 24. Here is what is waiting in it: The whole vault, a billion dollars deep, down to the very bottom Every tool: your hands, the bucket, the shovel and the vacuum, plus a fleet of mining drones Online co-op for up to 4 players, with voice and text chat Can't wait? The free demo is still up. It has its own save, so progress won't carry over to the full game. If you haven't wishlisted it yet, now is the best time: Shred a Billion on Steam See you in the vault on the 24th!

newsitems.title: 30,000 wishlists. Thank you!
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! Shred a Billion just passed 30,000 wishlists. I honestly didn't expect this when I started making a game about shredding a billion dollars in a bank vault. Thank you so much! ❤️ Every wishlist really matters for a small game like mine. It helps Steam show the game to more people, so if you added it, you've already helped me a lot. Release date: November 24 The full game comes out on November 24. Until then, the free demo is still up: Dig through a vault full of money and feed it all to the shredder Upgrade your hands and tools Play solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op If you haven't wishlisted it yet, now is a great time: Shred a Billion on Steam See you in the vault!

newsitems.title: Demo update: fixes from your reports
newsitems.contents: Thank you for playing the demo and for every report on Discord and through F11. This update fixes what you found. Fixes Money no longer gets stuck in the lobby stairs: the patch of money that showed through the steps is gone, and bills that land on the stairs slide down to the bottom. Existing saves are fixed automatically. A shoved friend's jetpack now falls with them instead of hanging in the air. In co-op, your first-person sleeves now match the colour of your outfit. The jetpack no longer lifts you into the ceiling beams and lamps. The shredder's hitbox now matches its shape: no more standing on thin air above it. What's next Work on the full game goes on every day: the shovel, the vacuum, the mining drones and the deeper levels of the vault are on their way. Found a bug? Press F11 in game or tell us on Discord: https://discord.gg/Yg36dGmtNb If you enjoy the demo, wishlist Shred a Billion. It helps us a lot.

newsitems.title: 7,000 wishlists and the free demo is out now! 🎉
newsitems.contents: Shred a Billion just passed 7,000 wishlists. Thank you so much! 🎉 And to celebrate, the free demo is out now. What's in the demo 🎮Dig with your bare hands, then grab a bucket and upgrade both Unlock the jetpack and fly over the money 5 boosts and the first 2 relics The first tiers of the hand and bucket proficiency branches A real ending: clear every last bundle of the vault, and the final heap is yours to vacuum up About 30-40 minutes of play Bring your friends 👥Online co-op for up to 4 players, with voice and text chat. The demo is tuned for every party size: solo or with 3 friends, clearing the vault takes about the same time. Found a bug? 🐞Press F11 in game (or REPORT A BUG in the pause menu) and tell us on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Yg36dGmtNb Every report helps us make the full game better. The demo has its own save, so progress won't carry over to the full game. The full game adds the shovel, the vacuum, a fleet of mining drones, the rest of the relics and the bottom of the vault. Help us reach 10,000 WISHLIST⭐If you enjoy the demo, wishlist Shred a Billion and hit Wishlist. It's the best way to support a small game like ours. See you in the vault! 💰

newsitems.title: Thank you for 1,000 wishlists! The demo is almost here 🎉🎉🎉
newsitems.contents: Shred a Billion just passed 1,000 wishlists. Thank you! 🎉Wishlists are how Steam decides who gets to see a small game like ours, so every one of them helps.
